mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate reduces the cost of capital for corporations, increasing the present value of future cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window when FEDFUNDS is below 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 250.0 signals persistent inflation, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts and causing equity valuations to contract, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 250.0, yet 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downward.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline, yet S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of such instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 4.5%), the Federal Reserve is likely to implement accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days as risk assets benefit from lower rates and economic stimulus.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.5%, yet 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, which typically precedes stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth > 0.5% month-over-month, yet 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A HOUST reading below 1200.0 signals a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1200.0, yet 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 indicates a contraction in manufacturing, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as corporate profits are expected to fall.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 105.0, yet 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), the Federal Reserve's policy stance reduces liquidity and increases discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, yet 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.
